_readme: General Catalyst's marketing-rule list at https://www.generalcatalyst.com/list ('All companies'), parsed by scratch/pull-compliance-list.py from the page cached by pull-site-gc.py. The list's own caveat is kept verbatim in 'caveat': it declares exclusions for confidentiality, so absence from it is strong evidence, not proof. `legal_name` is the page's string; `registered_name` drops legal suffixes and annotations; `name` is the portfolio grid's rendering where the two surfaces name one company (grid_slug), else the trading name (alias) or the registered name.
caveat: The following is a list of investments made by General Catalyst, and is for illustrative purposes only. Certain investments were excluded from this list due to confidentiality provisions. There is no guarantee that any of these investments will be profitable. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results. This list is as of June 30th, 2026.
